Anya: Ok team — drafting the release notes for next micro-deploy. Need a short internal blurb + timeline. Can someone confirm staging/prod windows and pin/version we want to call out? cc @deploy-bot
Sam: Staging target: Mon 22:00 UTC. Prod target: Tue 03:00 UTC. Canary at +15m then ramp. Pin model-serving to `v2.3.1` for rollout.
Mike: One-liner suggestion: "Reduce token latency by ~12% via runtime kernel update; no schema changes." Keep it non-technical for broader audience, detail in ops bullets.
Lina: For internal announce, add audience note: platform teams + integrations only for this micro-release. No customer-facing blast.
Jordan: Legal quick check — anything PII/contract change? We should loop in Legal if yes.
Anya: No PII, just infra perf. Notifying SRE and Support. Jordan — tagging legal FYI only.
Sam: Rollback criteria: if 95p latency regresses >5% OR error-rate >0.5% sustained for 10m. Owner: @Sam (eng-runtime).
Mike: Add perf dashboard link and canary checklist in the note. Example bullets: - dashboard: https://dash.redwood/perf/serving-2.3.1 - canary checklist: ✅ smoke, ✅ latency, ✅ errors
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2024-05-07T22:15:00Z -> ramp to 25% after 15m if smoke checks pass. Prod deploy window reserved: 2024-05-08T03:00:00Z.
Lina: Microcopy for internal slack: "Heads-up: small infra release (model-serving v2.3.1). Expect brief canary Mon 22:15 UTC; full roll Tue 03:00 UTC. Watch perf dashboard."
Anya: Love it. Can someone paste the RN bullets here and I'll stitch into the internal announce?
Sam: Bullets: - What: runtime kernel update (v2.3.1) - Why: ~12% token latency improvement - Impact: no API changes, potential perf wins for real-time routes - Rollback: criteria above; rollback plan: immediate pin to v2.3.0 and scale down canary - Owners: Sam (runtime), Anya (comms), SRE oncall
Mike: Ops bullets: - Preflight: smoke on staging, load sanity at 10k req/s - During canary: continuous tracing, KV cache checks - Post-roll: confirm cold-start p95 < previous baseline
Jordan: Thx. Legal: no issues from our side. You can mark legal cleared.
Anya: Draft internal announce (short): 
"Heads-up: We’ll deploy model-serving v2.3.1 (runtime kernel update) — expected ~12% token latency improvement. Canary Mon 22:15 UTC; prod Tue 03:00 UTC. No API changes. Owners: Sam, Anya. Read more: <ops checklist link>."
Lina: Can we include a line: "If you own an integration and see regressions, escalate to #support immediately"?
Anya: Yep adding. Final ask: please react with :thumbsup: once you've reviewed so I can pin and send at T-2h.
Sam: :thumbsup:
Mike: :thumbsup:
Lina: :thumbsup:
Jordan: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: send internal blast at 2024-05-08T01:00:00Z unless cancelled.
Anya: Thanks — pinning RN and will queue the internal blast. Will post final snippet here at T-3h.
